tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Find current catalog products using the same search and filters as the storefront. Returns a bounded page with an exact total; narrow overly broad queries. Public; no OAuth required. Read-only.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Read a current product, price, aggregate warehouse stock and public characteristics. Stock does not promise same-day pickup; unknown values remain null. Public; no OAuth required. Read-only.

tools.name: search_brands
tools.description: Find brands through the storefront brand search, including its typo suggestions. Returns paginated public brand links. Public; no OAuth required. Read-only.

tools.name: get_catalog_filters
tools.description: Read real contextual catalog filters for a section or brand. Use returned IDs when searching; do not invent characteristic IDs. Public; no OAuth required. Read-only.

tools.name: get_product_reviews
tools.description: Read only moderated, published product reviews with real rating data and pagination. Public; no OAuth required. Read-only.

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Read the consenting buyer's existing basket and recheck its current prices and stock. OAuth scopes: cart:read. Read-only.

tools.name: add_cart_item
tools.description: Add a product quantity to the consenting buyer's existing basket. Quantity is an increment; do not retry blindly or use this to create an order. OAuth scopes: cart:write. Changes buyer or order state.

tools.name: update_cart_item
tools.description: Set the absolute quantity of an item in this buyer's basket. Quantity zero removes it. OAuth scopes: cart:write. Changes buyer or order state.

tools.name: remove_cart_item
tools.description: Remove an item owned by this buyer from their existing basket. OAuth scopes: cart:write. Changes buyer or order state.

tools.name: get_favorites
tools.description: Read the consenting buyer's existing favorites. OAuth scopes: favorites:read. Read-only.

tools.name: add_favorite
tools.description: Add a current public product to this buyer's favorites. OAuth scopes: favorites:write. Changes buyer or order state.

tools.name: remove_favorite
tools.description: Remove a product from this buyer's favorites. OAuth scopes: favorites:write. Changes buyer or order state.

tools.name: get_checkout
tools.description: Read current checkout details, validation and available store options. Unquoted delivery and final totals stay null; no payment is made. OAuth scopes: checkout:read. Read-only.

tools.name: update_checkout
tools.description: Update the buyer's delivery, payment or contact choices in the existing checkout. Does not send an order or make a payment. OAuth scopes: checkout:write. Changes buyer or order state.

tools.name: prepare_order
tools.description: Prepare an exact current order summary and a short-lived browser confirmation link. The buyer must personally approve that summary; this does not submit it. OAuth scopes: order:prepare. Changes buyer or order state.

tools.name: submit_order
tools.description: Submit only an order already approved by the buyer in the confirmation page. Requires the returned token and a stable unique idempotency_key; retry the same key after uncertainty. Never bypass confirmation. OAuth scopes: order:submit. Changes buyer or order state.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Read an order created by this application for the same buyer session, including after reauthorization. Saving means submitted, not confirmed by the store; unavailable history or confirmation data remain null. OAuth scopes: orders:read. Read-only.

tools.name: list_webhooks
tools.description: List this application and buyer session's order event subscriptions. Signing secrets are never returned again. OAuth scopes: webhooks:read. Read-only.

tools.name: create_webhook
tools.description: Create a pending order event subscription to a public HTTPS receiver. Returns its signing secret ONCE. The receiver must echo the signed verification challenge before activation. No customer contact fields are sent. Check expires_at and requires_active_grant. OAuth scopes: webhooks:write, orders:rea

tools.name: delete_webhook
tools.description: Revoke an owned order event subscription and cancel queued deliveries. An already in-flight HTTPS request cannot be recalled. OAuth scopes: webhooks:write. Changes buyer or order state.

tools.name: list_webhook_deliveries
tools.description: Read the latest 100 delivery attempts for an owned subscription, without event payloads or secrets. OAuth scopes: webhooks:read. Read-only.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "submit_order" stacks urgency/override words (never, bypass). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_product_reviews · Private data: update_checkout, submit_order, list_webhooks, create_webhook, list_webhook_deliveries · Public sink: update_checkout, prepare_order, submit_order, create_webhook, delete_webhook, list_webhook_deliveries · Destructive: remove_cart_item, remove_favorite, delete_webhook.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_product_reviews · Private data: update_checkout, submit_order, list_webhooks, create_webhook, list_webhook_deliveries · Public sink: update_checkout, prepare_order, submit_order, create_webhook, delete_webhook, list_webhook_deliveries · Destructive: remove_cart_item, remove_favorite, delete_webhook

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
